_comment: Randomly generated by scripts/gen_random_workload.py (seed=0).

Hardware: qrb5165_flowc -- QRB5165 v66 through Flow C: HTA (CPU_P) + Hexagon v66 DSP (CPU_E) + Kryo 585 CPU (CPU_X), one lane each. Profiles are the tile-level results.csv files flowc/artifacts.py writes from measurements/qrb5165_v66.json.

Periodic taskset -- each model runs at its OWN period, drawn from the model bank's period_ms and snapped to a multiple of the fastest task's (7 ms) so the hyperperiod is just the slowest period (14 ms):
mlp_control: period 7 ms (142.9 Hz), 1 copy(ies), 0.107 ms each (serial on CPU, 1 dispatches), 1.5% of a core, 12 instances over the horizon
mlp_control: window 5 ms (drawn from window_ms 2-8 ms, then fitted to the period; deadline = 42.28x measured runtime), start_time 0 ms
fused_split: period 14 ms (71.4 Hz), 1 copy(ies), 5.154 ms each (serial on DSP, 3 dispatches), 36.8% of a core, 6 instances over the horizon
fused_split: window 11 ms (drawn from window_ms 5-20 ms, then fitted to the period; deadline = 1.98x measured runtime), start_time 0 ms
Peak backend utilization of the periodic set: 0.37 (budget 0.75) -- CPU 0.02/1, DSP 0.37/1, HTA 0.00/1.
Copies capped by the model bank's max_copies:
mlp_control: 2 copies -> 1 -- copies of a model are concurrent (shared period, back-to-back in the frame), and the bank allows 1 of this one at a time
Rates adjusted to fit this hardware:
fused_split: 2 copies -> 1 -- 5.154 ms each does not fit 2 times into a 14 ms frame with 1.25x headroom
Horizon 79 ms = 3.0 x hyperperiod; num_instances is ceil(horizon / period) per network, 40 operations in total.

Sporadic tasks placed in the gaps with non-overlapping windows, no edges to the periodic taskset (an edge across the boundary fans out to every periodic instance): yolov8n_a [7, 139] ms, yolov8n_b [168, 218] ms, yolov8n_c [224, 269] ms, yolov8n_d [305, 447] ms, vint [523, 814] ms.

Edges chain the copies of one model, which share its period; models at different rates get none, because workload_factory pairs periodic instances by index and that only means something at equal periods.
No p_core_speedup: it scales only the synthetic-timing fallback, so applying it on top of profiled CSVs would fabricate timings.

fused_split: FusedSensorNet cut into its two parallel conv branches plus the LSTM tail (3 tiles). This is the `fused_full` of SETUP.md's arm table -- SETUP.md's cell list for that arm is vision_conv/depth_conv/tail, which are fused_split's tiles, not the monolith's single fused_full_net cell. The split is also the only version with HTA coverage, so it is the one that exercises the third lane.

mlp_control: Control policy, 1 tile. CPU cell is the fp32 context (107.3 us): QnnCpu's int8 path returns a constant for this network regardless of input (measurements/qrb5165_v66.json, _correctness_note in bindings/mlp_control.json). HTA is capability-excluded (elu_s8), so its profile row carries the derived exclusion cost.

vint: ViNT visual-nav transformer, encoders + decoder (2 tiles). The encoders run on the DSP (14.2 ms) and the decoder only on the CPU. Its CPU cell is load-dependent by construction -- see the confounds section of SETUP.md.

yolov8n: 640x640 ultralytics export, backbone + head (2 tiles), ~28.6 ms serial on the DSP. The head is capability-excluded on HTA (Transpose), so its HTA profile row carries the derived exclusion cost. NOT the FPGA bank's 64x64 yolov8_nano -- no cross-target latency comparison is valid.
